name: Koru
description: Local MCP server built into the Koru notes app that lets MCP clients, including local Ollama models through OpenCode, search, read and edit notes kept on the device.
compatibility: MCP over stdio through the bundled koru-mcp bridge, with documented setups for Claude Desktop, ChatGPT/Codex and OpenCode.
Documented OpenCode setup with a tool-capable local Ollama model as the backend.
limitations: Koru's local store must be running; the MCP bridge reads and edits the workspace through it, and edits are semantic operations rather than raw file writes.
Windows is the supported platform; the Linux build is a nightly preview and public macOS builds are held, so macOS needs a source build.
The Ollama guide uses a source build on Windows; tool-calling quality depends on the chosen model, and the guide suggests a context window of at least 64K tokens for large sessions.
Usage telemetry is opt-in; official builds can optionally sign in to Koru Cloud, which is off in source builds.

sources.note: Documents the built-in MCP server, local storage, opt-in telemetry, optional Koru Cloud, MPL-2.0 license and platform status (Windows supported, Linux nightly preview, macOS builds held).
Documents connecting a local Ollama model to Koru through OpenCode with koru-mcp over stdio, and the model and context-window guidance.
Documents the MCP tool surface for listing, searching, reading, creating and editing documents and files.
